market_name: Will 6 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the probability shift persists or was a thin-liquidity blip; cross-check 2Y and 10Y yields and Fed funds futures for confirmation.
time_plan.1h: Look for a macro catalyst (weak jobs/inflation data, Fed speaker, risk-off event) that would justify a dovish repricing.
time_plan.2h: Confirm TLT direction tracks the rate-cut repricing; watch for divergence that would indicate the proxy is not responding.
time_plan.6h: Reassess against broader rates complex and whether US data releases occur in-window.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate realized TLT move vs expectation; document whether the prediction-market signal led or lagged the bond move.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 6 cuts (150bps of easing) in 2026 signals a much more dovish Fed path than currently priced, typically driven by expectations of weakening growth or falling inflation. That pulls the expected policy path lower, rallying front-end and long-end Treasuries and pushing TLT up. This is the cleanest, most direct mapping since the market is literally about Fed policy.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify the rate-cut repricing is real and check DXY reaction alongside 2Y yields.
time_plan.1h: Check whether other central banks are also being repriced dovish, which would offset the dollar move.
time_plan.2h: Confirm UUP weakness aligns with rate differentials rather than idiosyncratic FX flows.
time_plan.6h: Reassess for any risk-off dynamic that could paradoxically bid the dollar as a haven.
time_plan.12h: Compare realized UUP move to thesis and note signal quality.

predictions.reasoning: More aggressive expected Fed easing narrows US rate differentials versus other currencies, which is typically dollar-negative. A jump in the probability of 6 cuts would push UUP lower. This is a secondary, weaker mapping because FX also depends on relative central-bank paths abroad.

evidence_used: Market resolves on count of 25bps Fed cuts in 2026; 6 cuts implies ~150bps of easing, a strongly dovish outcome
Rate-cut expectations map directly to Treasury yields and the dollar via the policy path
Standard macro transmission: more easing -> lower yields (bonds up), narrower differentials (dollar down)
uncertainty_notes: The 700bps tradability threshold is far above any plausible 12h move in these liquid macro proxies, so neither prediction is 'tradable' under the stated rule
Prediction-market probability for a full-year 2026 outcome is a slow-moving, low-information sensor for intraday asset moves
Direction of the probability shift is not given; if the probability of 6 cuts FELL sharply, all signs reverse (hawkish, TLT down, dollar up)

llm_justification.summary: This market tracks how many 25bps Fed cuts occur in 2026; six cuts is a strongly dovish outcome. A sharp increase in that implied probability would signal a more dovish expected policy path, mapping to higher long Treasuries (TLT up) and a weaker dollar (UUP down). Both are directionally clean but small in magnitude over 12h — well below the 700bps tradability bar — so this is a low-confidence, research-only signal that also depends entirely on the unknown direction of the probability move.
key_assumptions: A meaningful, persistent shift in the implied probability of 6 cuts (not thin-market noise)
Assumed direction is an INCREASE in probability (more dovish); a decrease flips all signs
Standard rates/FX transmission holds and no dominant offsetting catalyst
failure_modes: Move is already public (driven by known data/Fed speak already reflected in bonds and FX)
The probability shift is noise from a thinly traded long-horizon market with no real information
Proxies barely move over 12h — expected magnitudes are an order of magnitude below the 700bps threshold
Risk-off interpretation could bid the dollar as a haven even amid dovish repricing, breaking the UUP mapping
Direction of the underlying probability change is unspecified, so the sign of the thesis may be inverted
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
